equipment_type: Room / indoor air quality controller (temperature, humidity, CO2, VOC)
applies_to: Neptronic AROB room controllers measuring temperature, humidity, CO2 and VOC, with 2 analog and 2 binary outputs.
summary: AROB is a wall-mount room controller for temperature, humidity, CO2 and VOC with BACnet MS/TP. The BACnet guide lists 166 objects: user system modes and setpoints, sensor readings, calculated enthalpy and dew point, demands per function and output, OAT and airflow lockout and filter alarms, and configuration objects for the outputs and inputs.
notes: Multistate state texts are listed as printed in the guide (option names in order, without numbers).
MSV.7 Cfg Object list mode (Integrator, Advanced, Factory) changes which objects are visible.
Sensor values can be overridden with Out_of_Service where the W? column says so.

integration.summary: Turn the controller on with MSV.1, pick the temperature mode with MSV.2 and write the cooling/heating setpoints AV.1/AV.2. Read AV.10 temperature, AV.11 humidity, AV.9 CO2, the demands and the filter/airflow alarm BVs.

minimum_points.name: User Temp system mode
minimum_points.why: Temperature mode: off, cool, auto, heat

integration.enable: MSV.1 User main system mode turns the controller off or on; MSV.2-MSV.6 set the temperature, humidity, CO2, VOC and fan modes.
setup: MSV.22 Cfg Network unit selects metric or imperial values on BACnet.
gotchas: Setpoints are limited by the deadbands and min/max configuration values.
